concerns.title: Authored Torch fixtures do not cover native FP32 or a nonidentity cross-node closure

evidence.detail: All factor vectors and reference tensors are float64.
Analytic Jacobian is node-local identity/2 and -identity/2.

concerns.impact: A pass qualifies the specified FP64 synthetic examples, not actual native FP32 arithmetic or reordered cross-node derivatives.
concerns.resolution: Retain the stated native actual-closure qualification requirement. An additional synthetic reordered mixed-Jacobian/FP32 case would strengthen coverage; it is not an invented condition for this source review.
concerns.independent_evidence: Exact rational nonidentity scatter/gather and nonlocal pullback sum checks passed in review_stdlib_checks.py. No Torch execution was performed by this reviewer.

concerns.title: A failed graph-bank receipt charges scheduled sparse products rather than completed products

evidence.detail: Three products are charged before the bank primitive is called.
The document discloses that an aborted bank can perform fewer products.

concerns.impact: graph_sparse_products alone cannot reconstruct the completed sparse-operation count after a bank exception; normal counts and acceptance remain correct.
concerns.resolution: Interpret this field as scheduled charges on abort. A future integration should record scheduled versus completed/unknown counts explicitly and preserve measured native costs.
